name: 2008 Wenchuan earthquake Yingxiu-Wenchuan road impact zone with OSM road network
evidence: The 2008 Wenchuan earthquake occurred in Sichuan on 2008-05-12. Public records describe severe shaking, landslides, road disruption, and heavy damage along the Longmenshan fault region.
mapping_note: OSM road segments intersecting the representative Yingxiu-Wenchuan earthquake impact buffer are marked as collapse or interruption risk.
